title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: customer-first direct callback with callback profiles
summary: The briefing passes: Microsoft documents the irreversible enablement, callback profiles, queue configuration and credit consumption it describes. The queue navigation is supported across the callback and overflow pages, and the automation is supported by the Dataverse base and Customer Service extension references.

claims.claim: Dynamics 365 Contact Center offers customer-first direct callback using callback profiles.
claims.quote: This approach helps optimize representative capacity and supports custom callback experiences through callback profiles.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Why it matters
claims.claim: Customer-first direct callback calls the customer before connecting a representative.
claims.quote: With customer-first direct callback, the system calls the customer first when the callback request reaches the front of the queue.

claims.claim: An AI agent can verify customers before the representative joins.
claims.quote: An AI agent can engage the customer, collect information, or perform verification.

claims.claim: The representative is connected after the customer answers and completes any required verification.
claims.quote: After the customer answers and completes any required verification, the system connects the customer to an available representative.

claims.claim: The enablement path is Copilot Service admin center > Routing > Callback management > Copilot AI agent for callback management > Customer-first direct callback.
claims.quote: go to Routing > Callback management. Enable Copilot AI agent for callback management. ... After provisioning completes, select the Customer-first direct callback toggle.

claims.claim: No API is documented for the complete irreversible onboarding sequence including Callback Agent provisioning; the config-table update is not mapped to that sequence.
claims.quote: Searched: "Callback Agent" "provision" API customer-first callback onboarding. Opened configure-customer-first-callback and the msdyn_proactive_callback_config reference; found UI onboarding and config-record updates, not automation of the complete sequence.

claims.claim: The profile wizard route reaches Retry Settings through Routing > Callback management > Create new direct callback profile > Dialing > Behaviors.
claims.quote: On Create new direct callback profile, enter the following details: ... On the Dialing page ... On the Behaviors page, in Retry Settings, select the retry options

claims.claim: POST /msdyn_proactive_callback_profiles creates a callback profile containing its configuration settings.
claims.quote: Configuration entity for callback profiles used in direct and scheduled callback scenarios. ... Create ... POST /msdyn_proactive_callback_profiles

claims.claim: The profile request body can set msdyn_number_of_retries.
claims.quote: Writable columns/attributes ... msdyn_number_of_retries ... Description: The number of reattempts allowed for a callback delivery. ... LogicalName: msdyn_number_of_retries

claims.claim: The profile request body can set msdyn_fallback_action.
claims.quote: Writable columns/attributes ... msdyn_fallback_action ... Determines the action to take when the callback bot fails. Hangup ends the call, Escalate transfers to a representative.

claims.claim: The printed queue route through Customer support, Queues, Advanced queues and prequeue overflow ends at Action > Direct callback > Callback profile.
claims.quote: select Customer support > Queues. Select Advanced queues ... Under Overflow handling, select Add condition-action pair. ... in Before work items are queued, select Add condition-action pair. ... Condition ... Action

claims.claim: PATCH /msdyn_overflowactionconfigs(msdyn_overflowactionconfigid) updates an overflow action configuration to associate its callback profile.
claims.quote: Update ... PATCH /msdyn_overflowactionconfigs(msdyn_overflowactionconfigid) See Update

claims.claim: The Customer Service extension reference documents the writable msdyn_proactive_callback_profileId lookup used to associate an overflow action with a callback profile.
claims.quote: Writable columns/attributes ... msdyn_proactive_callback_profileId ... Lookup to the Callback Profile associated with overflow action config ... ReferencingEntityNavigationPropertyName: msdyn_proactive_callback_profileId

claims.claim: In classic direct callback the system assigns the callback request to a representative before calling the customer.
claims.quote: In the classic direct callback experience, the system assigns a callback request to a representative before it calls the customer.

claims.claim: In the classic experience a representative waits while an unanswered, voicemail or unavailable-number call attempt completes.
claims.quote: If the customer doesn't answer, the call reaches voicemail, or the number is unavailable, the representative waits while the call attempt completes.

claims.claim: Administrators configure callback behaviour using profiles in Copilot Service admin center.
claims.quote: Callback profiles control how callbacks are handled for customers. Create multiple profiles and apply them to different queues or overflow scenarios
